$comment: Every background worker in this product runs as a cron route inside the one Next.js service, not as a standalone deployable. This registry is what makes each one independently versioned and releasable anyway: a name, a role, a version with a changelog, the job queues it produces into or claims from, and what happens to the work it holds when a deployment replaces it mid-run. apps/web/app/api/cron/deployable-components.test.ts is the gate; it runs in CI's js-verify lane, so an unregistered route, an unknown queue, an unanswered in-flight contract or a version without a changelog entry fails the build.

inference.note: Model inference itself is request-path work in the web service, not a worker. The scheduled part is which model a request is served by, and that is evaluate-model-rollout.

sync.note: Object backup replication is the only scheduled sync; everything else syncs in the request that caused it.

projection.note: Derived product metrics are rolled up on a schedule; every other projection is computed on read.

billing.note: Credit reset, reconciliation, reservation recovery, auto-reload, provider-cost reconciliation, enterprise metering and collection enforcement.

ingestion.note: Document ingestion is the retrieval index pipeline; the cron starts a durable workflow run and does not itself carry the ingestion.

connector-sync.note: The connector and plugin directories are refreshed on a schedule; a user's own connector calls run in their request.

search-index.note: One component, index-retrieval-documents, owns both ingestion and indexing.

scheduler.note: run-schedules is the scheduler; Vercel cron is the timer that drives it and every other component here.

sandbox-runner.note: Sandboxes execute in the E2B and Vercel Sandbox services, outside this deployable. reclaim-sandboxes is the part that runs here.

cleanup.note: Retention, expiry, purge and reap. Each is bounded per run and resumes from its own predicate, so none of them can be left half-done by a deployment.

queue.note: The queue is Postgres: apps/web/db/neon/0208_background_jobs.sql plus the per-queue policy in apps/web/lib/jobs/job-queues.ts. drain-background-jobs is its consumer. There is no separate broker, and a claimed job is released by lease expiry rather than by a shutdown hook.

observability.note: The health probe, the SLO burn evaluator, the security anomaly pager and the free quota renewal reminder. health-probe is the health endpoint this deployable is measured by.
